title: ETH Zürich Teaches a Humanoid to Climb, Vault and Recover by Planning Body Contacts
summary: Tested on a Unitree G1, the research combines human motion data and reinforcement learning to connect mobility skills using onboard terrain sensing.
points: With Rich Robinson, Clinical Professor of Entrepreneurship at Peking University

Researchers at ETH Zürich's Robotic Systems Lab and collaborators have demonstrated a Unitree G1 climbing ladders, scaling obstacles and recovering from falls with a single learned locomotion policy .

Their approach, Attention-based Contact Planning (ACP) , focuses on where the robot should place its body against the environment, allowing a controller to work out the movements between those contacts.

title: Teradyne Robotics partners with Sereact to scale physical AI in retail and logistics
summary: Sereact and Teradyne have already shipped hundreds of UR robots in dual-arm systems to live customer sites across Europe.

Teradyne Robotics, the company behind Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots, last week partnered with Sereact.

Through this partnership, Sereact’s Cortex physical AI platform runs robot arms from Universal Robots to give retailers and logistics providers a proven way to automate unstructured tasks such as returns handling and piece picking.
